what_to_detect: A resolution makes a player discard (or draw) a split card, and the split card counts as one card.
near_miss: Not distinct within the rule: the contrast is a discard of a non-split card, also counted as one.
record_fields: entity of the discarded card (split layout, two faces)

what_to_detect: A split card's half is a candidate of its own, evaluated on that half's cost and requirements only, and is affordable with the available mana.
near_miss: A split card's half not affordable with the available mana, whatever the other half costs.
record_fields: candidate acting line (the split half's spell line, its face in the provenance key)

what_to_detect: A candidate that targets spells by a characteristic has a split-card spell on the stack as a legal target because the half being cast has that characteristic.
near_miss: The same kind of candidate with no legal target because only the other half of the split card on the stack has the characteristic.
record_fields: stack entity of the split spell (name, colors, mana value)

what_to_detect: A copy of a split card keeps both halves separated, and the copy is cast as either half and resolves as that half.
near_miss: Not distinct within the rule: the contrast is a copy of a non-split card, which has one set of characteristics.
record_fields: acting line face in the provenance key

what_to_detect: Outside the stack a split card has the combined mana value of its halves, so an effect searching for a card by mana value judges it by the combined value.
near_miss: A library card whose own mana value meets the search condition, which the search finds.

what_to_detect: A split card has the chosen name when either of its two names is the name chosen, and the effect acts on it.
near_miss: A chosen name that is neither of the split card's names, so the effect does not act on it.

what_to_detect: A candidate that targets spells by mana value has a split-card spell on the stack as a legal target by the mana value of the half being cast.
near_miss: The same kind of candidate with no legal target because the half being cast has a different mana value.
record_fields: stack entity of the split spell (mana value)

what_to_detect: A split card outside the stack has every card type of either half, so a static counting card types among cards in a zone counts both halves' types.
near_miss: The same static with no split card in the zone, its count from single-faced cards only.
record_fields: state entities of the zone's cards (types)

what_to_detect: A candidate that targets spells by a characteristic has a fused split spell as a legal target because the fused spell has both halves' characteristics combined.
near_miss: The same kind of candidate with no legal target because only one half was cast, without fuse, and lacks the characteristic.
record_fields: stack entity of the fused spell (colors)

what_to_detect: A trigger printed on a Room half whose door is unlocked exists and fires on its event.
near_miss: The same event while that half is locked: the half has no rules text, so no trigger record for it exists and its line is inactive.

what_to_detect: A candidate that targets spells by card type has a Room spell as a legal target by the types of its shared type line.
near_miss: The same kind of candidate with no legal target because the split spell on the stack has no shared type line and its cast half lacks the type.

what_to_detect: A Room permanent enters the battlefield without either half having been cast, and has neither unlocked designation: no unlock trigger is evaluated.
near_miss: A Room whose half was cast enters with that half's unlocked designation, and its unlock triggers are evaluated.
record_fields: resolution zone_change event to the battlefield

what_to_detect: A Room unlock special-action candidate passes the timing check: its controller's main phase, with an empty stack.
near_miss: A Room unlock candidate that fails the timing check: not its controller's turn, not a main phase, or the stack not empty.
record_fields: candidate acting line (Forge builds the action at runtime as an ST$ UnlockDoor ability, so it may join no sidecar line)

what_to_detect: A resolution unlocks a locked half of a Room permanent, which gains that half's unlocked designation.
near_miss: A resolution of an unlock effect on a Room with no locked half, which changes no designation.
record_fields: gen-3 card designations in the snapshots before and after the effect half
no event: ApiEvents has no UnlockDoor rule, so the effect half holds no state_flag_change for it

what_to_detect: A resolution locks an unlocked half of a Room permanent, which loses that half's unlocked designation.
near_miss: A resolution of a lock effect on a Room with no unlocked half, which changes no designation.
record_fields: gen-3 card designations in the snapshots before and after the effect half
no event: ApiEvents has no UnlockDoor rule, so the effect half holds no state_flag_change for it
